message: The scene 'Level' is declared in 'src/other.mtek', but scenes belong in the entry module 'src/main.mtek'.
notes: the scenes of a program share one set of names, `go_to` targets, shared state and saved state, which is checked over the entry module
help: move the scene into the entry module; prefabs, materials, structs, enums, functions and constants can stay in imported modules
